description: Defines the FrameDecoderState class which manages state and behaviors for decoding HTTP/2 frame headers and payloads, including buffer management, padding, and listener callbacks.

classes.name: FrameDecoderState
classes.description: Manages decoding state for HTTP/2 frames, including header, payload, padding, and listener interactions.

methods.name: set_listener
methods.description: Sets the listener for frame decoding events.

methods.name: listener
methods.description: Returns the current frame decoder listener.

methods.name: frame_header
methods.description: Returns the most recently decoded frame header.

methods.name: StartDecodingStructureInPayload
methods.description: Decodes a structure within the payload buffer, updating remaining payload size.

methods.name: ResumeDecodingStructureInPayload
methods.description: Resumes decoding a split structure within the payload buffer.

methods.name: InitializeRemainders
methods.description: Initializes remaining payload and padding counters based on the frame header.

methods.name: remaining_total_payload
methods.description: Returns total remaining bytes of payload including padding.

methods.name: remaining_payload
methods.description: Returns remaining payload bytes excluding padding.

methods.name: remaining_payload_and_padding
methods.description: Returns remaining payload plus padding bytes.

methods.name: AvailablePayload
methods.description: Returns how many payload bytes are available in the buffer.

methods.name: AvailablePayloadAndPadding
methods.description: Returns how many payload and padding bytes are available in the buffer.

methods.name: AvailablePadding
methods.description: Returns how many padding bytes are available in the buffer.

methods.name: ConsumePayload
methods.description: Reduces remaining payload size after decoding part of the payload.

methods.name: ReadPadLength
methods.description: Reads the padding length field from the payload.

methods.name: SkipPadding
methods.description: Skips over padding bytes after payload decoding.

methods.name: ReportFrameSizeError
methods.description: Handles frame size errors by notifying listener and returning error status.
